DefaultDescriptionFormat.SourceString:
Equippable as ammo when using a Magic Weapon (provided the required Skill Perk is unlocked).

A symbol of flowing waters, essential for water-based magic and other spells. 

Runes are retained if you happen to die.
DefaultDescriptionFormat.LocalizedString:
Equippable as ammo when using a Magic Weapon (provided the required Skill Perk is unlocked).

Runes are retained if you happen to die.

Description.SourceString: Water is a strange thing, required by all living things, yet capable of ending civilisations. Rain is vital to the survival of a kingdom, yet its citizens lament the grey clouds forming overhead. Mages understand that water is a special sort of power, capable of being shaped in a multitude of ways. Water runes embody this fluidity of concept, finding use in many different types of spell.
